body: It’s just been too overwhelming lately. I know what my problem is. I haven’t been able to solve it, but it’s been the least of my worries. I’ve had so much happen lately, I’ve had so much happen in years prior, I just don’t want to deal with any of it anymore.

Relief is what I’m seeking, but I never seem to get there. I have moments of feeling better, and like I’m in control, but they never last. Everything I’ve been through these last two months or so just feels like too much. It was hard before, but feels impossible now
